Food Bundle

You unwrap a little comfort from home and share the smell of a proper meal.

Rules

- ID: item-food-bundle - Bulk: 1 - Requirements / supply: Inventory d8 - Acquisition: Explicit ability grant, coins, or DA treasure; no automatic extra starting kit.

One supply check per person-day consumed. No exhaustion subsystem is implied.

No DP price. Purchase does not grant training or an ability.

Equipment index

Market price: 9 coins. Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
